title: Correlate Codex quota error observations with the active turn
outcome: A stale or uncorrelated Codex error notification cannot create the Auto evaluator vendor quota window; existing terminal and provider retry behavior stays unchanged.
acceptance: A mismatched turnId and a missing turnId are exercised through the production Codex notification path; neither creates a quota window without a documented existing current-turn ownership proof.

A current correlated non-retrying usageLimitExceeded terminal still affects Auto, while stale, retry and overload cases preserve their existing behavior; explicit evaluator preference remains unchanged.
